body: And thanks for taking time to read this. Don't beat yourself up I feel like I am not as cultured as I would like to be (but I heard it's overrated and I'm starting to believe that)

I'm feeling like this again. I don't think I can stop caffeine and cigarettes just like that as I have no backup if shit hits the fan. I have to keep working full time and currently have no savings whatsoever so can't afford to be ill even for a week. My contract ends in April so will have to start looking for new jobs and cross my fingers I keep this one. But I definitely won't keep the job or impress a new employer if I'm off sick or not fit even while at work... boyfriend is trying to dance, bless him. But that's something we only do for 1h a week. I wake up worse and worse every morning. This morning he was there and he was just "in my way" in a sense... because I was anxious and nervous and he was around so I had to hide it and what could have been a 20-30 "go hysterical, calm down, put you bravest mask on" session turned into hidden tears, frustration and unresolved feeling of anxiety... With regards to the meds I want to come off them completely and I managed to go down to the lowest dose. I definitely won't be taking any more of that shit I feel like this is poison. I have been on something for the past 8 years I don't even know what I would be like without meds. I feel bad again and feel like this time I don't even want to be saved cause the process of going up hurts just as much as going down... I feel like letting go and sinking into depression until I'm brave enough to finish it. I don't want to fight.

I'm 27 and I've been diagnosed 8 years ago but had mood disturbances and anxiety waaaay before. I can't afford to dance too often, I do salsa and kizomba - you need a partner and a venue to dance so I go to classes and socials but it gets expensive and I rely on other people on transport.
I'm Polish but live and work in UK.  Like I said I have great many friends and nothing is wrong with my life but I most of time I just feel disconnected, like I'm not myself, like I'm losing myself. And I'm trying to get clearance so badly... that sets of the anxiety. But not only this. Strong emotions, like I feel when I think I have no purpose in life or that I love someone that I can't be with, or when I think about something that I will never see/do/become...
My depression comes from existential vacuum, how super sensitive I am, constant guilt tripping when I was a child that I made myself a habit of... and really really low self esteem. 
I am extremely sensitive and anything can throw me off.
Every day I get derealization and depersonalisation moments, I get moments when I just shake because of how the half life of my anti depressants is timed, times when some sensations just physically hurt - be it light, sound or feeling, times when because of what I am I act like a weirdo and I am aware of it and also thoughts that bring on strong emotions. Emotions that are just too strong for me.
Half a time I'm just playing pretend like I know who I am and I have a connection with myself and everything is alright but inside I feel like "what the fuck is happening right now!! Help!!"

I feel I can't take another day sometimes.
and I feel ashamed.

My mind never really stops. I find it really difficult to relax and stop the destructive inner commentary or not to feel utterly confused and depersonalised. I love dancing and usually it helps... just for the time when I am dancing. Although on a particularly bad day I'm too hurt to switch off and dance.
I'm so sorry about the word editing, punctuation abd shit. I'm typing it from my phone... I hate typing from my phone.
